outputs.justify_why_test_is_missing: The panel shows quantitative time-course data (normalized intensity traces), averaged responses and fitted model curves, and makes claims that the diffusion-limited model fits euchromatin but fails for heterochromatin and that residence is longer in heterochromatin. To support these claims, the authors should report: sample sizes (number of cells/experiments), what the error bars represent (SD or SEM), statistical comparisons between euchromatin and heterochromatin (e.g., test on fitted parameters such as residence time or on early-time plateau values), and formal model-comparison metrics (goodness-of-fit, AIC/BIC or extra-sum-of-squares F-test) to justify that one model is significantly worse. Without these details, the significance of the observed differences cannot be assessed and the claims remain qualitative.
